title: A highly-sensitive sandwich ELISA procedure based on one-step antibody immobilization for potential _in vitro_ diagnostics
protocol: Mix anti-HFA capture Ab with APTES in a ratio of 1:1 (v/v).
Incubate the mixture in desired wells of a 96-well MTP for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash each well five times with 300 μL of 0.1M PBS, pH 7.4.
Block Ab-bound wells with 300 µL of 1% (w/v) filtered BSA for 30 min at 37°C.
Add 100 µL of varying HFA concentrations to different BSA-blocked wells.
Incubate the mixture in each well for 1 h at 37°C.
Add 100 µL of biotinylated anti-HFA Ab (200 ng/mL) to the HFA-captured wells.
Add 100 µL of streptavidin-HRP conjugate diluted 1:200 to biotinylated anti-HFA Ab treated wells.
Add 100 µL of TMB-H₂O₂ mixture to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for color development for 20 min.
Add 50 µL of 1 N H₂SO₄ to each well to stop the reaction.
Determine the absorbance at a primary wavelength of 450 nm and a reference wavelength of 540 nm in the Tecan Infinite M200 Pro microplate reader.
Determine the absorbance within 10 min of stopping the enzyme-substrate reaction.
